facts.fact: SARS says its Client Information System, implemented in 2014, lets taxpayers register for and maintain tax and customs registrations in one consolidated profile, with additional registrations done on eFiling or at a branch.

note: Tax statistics release with revenue figures; states nothing about a taxpayer register or number.
The passage supplied states nothing on the taxpayer register.
An existing taxpayer register is referred to only in passing, with no statement of a computerised register or number.
The tax register is said to have grown by 411,000 companies and 1.1 million individuals, but nothing says it is computerised, shared or tied to the ID.
